Name: Yellow Dress Cleavage Brunette Leah
Author: nicolitox
Description:
[size=5]CREDITS TO [color=#e69138]AIRPLANE RANDY[/color] FOR HIS WORK ON THE [color=#0000ff][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/lewd-bachelorettes-portrait-mod-buxom-haley-added.108210/]LEWD BACHELORETTES[/url][/color] THAT I USED AS A BASE FOR THIS WORK.
[size=3]
So here is my first work on Stardew Valley. I just edited Leah's sprite and portrait [color=#ff0000][color=#e69138](by AirplaneRandy)[/color] [color=#f4f4f4]to how I always wanted Leah to be.
She now has a [color=#ffff00]yellow dress[/color] that covers her feet, [color=#b6d7a8]light green eyes[/color], [color=#cc0000]red lipstick[/color], and [color=#5B0F00]dark brown hair[/color] that falls as a semi ponytail on her back instead of the regular over-the-shoulder braid.
You can also notice [color=#ff00ff]her chest being bigger[/color] not only in her portrait but her sprite too. Yay!
Installation
- Replace the file in your game directory in /Content/Characters/Leah.xnb with the Leah.xnb from the Characters folder in the YellowBrunetteLeah.Rar
-[size=5][size=3][color=#ff0000][color=#f4f4f4]Replace the file in your game directory in /Content/Portraits/Leah.xnb with the Leah.xnb from the Portraits folder in the YellowBrunetteLeah.Rar
Enjoy!
